function.name: RtlFindLeastSignificantBit
function.header_comment:
/*************************************************************************
 * RtlFindLeastSignificantBit	[NTDLL.@]
 *
 * Find the least significant bit in a 64 bit integer.
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  The position of the least significant bit.
 */
